title_rules.description: DESCRIPTION
Brand name is always Slot 1. It's the highest-value keyword for branded search and trust signals.
The single most-searched sizing/capacity spec goes in Slot 2. This varies by category: Cu. Ft. for refrigerators, Width for ranges, BTU for HVAC, Blade Span for fans.
The key differentiator that narrows the product type. French Door vs Side-by-Side, Gas vs Electric, Pull-Down vs Pull-Out.
How it's installed: Built-In, Freestanding, Wall-Mount, Undermount. Only include if it adds value (skip if category implies it).
Always include the exact category name for search relevance. This is what matches Google Shopping taxonomy.
Finish or color is a top aesthetic filter. Use the most specific term: 'Brushed Nickel' not just 'Nickel'. 'Stainless Steel' not 'Silver'.
Max 2-3 high-value features in parentheses. Only features that drive purchase decisions or differentiate from competitors.
Target 60-80 characters for Google SERP. Absolute max 150 characters. Front-load the most important keywords.
If category is nearly always one size (24" dishwashers, 30" ranges) — UNLESS the product is a non-standard size.
If it's redundant with the category or configuration (e.g., 'Wall Oven' already implies wall installation).
If there are no differentiating features, or if the title is already at max length.
For products where capacity isn't a meaningful differentiator (faucets, hardware, lighting).
Always use 'X-Inch' format with hyphen: '30-Inch', '36-Inch'. For W×H: '36×80-Inch'.
Use 'XX Cu. Ft.' with period after Cu: '28 Cu. Ft.' not '28 cu ft' or '28cf'.
Use comma separator: '50,000 BTU' not '50000 BTU'. No 'BTU/hr'.
Decimal format: '9.8 GPM' not '9.8 gallons per minute'.
Plain number with unit: '600 CFM' not '600 cubic feet per minute'.
Plain number with unit: '44 dBA' not '44 decibels'.
Use 'W' abbreviation: '1500W' not '1500 Watts'.
Decimal format: '12 kW' not '12 kilowatts'.
Use 'MERV XX' format: 'MERV 11' not 'MERV-11'.
Use 'X-Foot' for track/barn door: '8-Foot' not '8 ft' or '96-Inch'.
Use "W×L" or "W×H×D" format: '20×25×4-Inch' for air filters.
